text:
Type: faux fur throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: soft shaggy faux fur
Colors: light warm grey, greige
Shape: square, plush mottled pile, knife edges, plump and full
Feel: cozy, soft, luxurious
Goes with: white, grey or velvet sofas, knit throws, brass accents; glam or Scandinavian bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Soft Faux Fur Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Grey
product.description: Add a touch of luxury to your room with this plush pillow. Amazingly soft faux fur exudes glamour along with warmth and coziness. For a different look, flip it over to the solid grey side. Neutral grey will enhance any style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
